Chapter 7025: Xiaolou Tingxue

Chapter 7025: Xiaolou Tingxue

“Well said.” Li Qiye smiled: “I wonder if you can always maintain this pride or rather, grow strong enough to justify it.”

“Of course.” Xiaolou Tingxue’s eyes exuded saber energy, cutting through space and leaving gashes with chaos energy.

The energy alone could cause damage to the tenacious immortal bodies. Xiaolou Tingxue was undoubtedly a primordial immortal, and a top one at that.

“Such confidence, but that can be shattered.” Li Qiye said.

“I don’t mind trying.” He responded.

“You won’t last a few moves.” Li Qiye said.

“I don’t care if you are the high heaven, I will show you my fangs.” He said.

“Even if it means dying?” Li Qiye asked.

Listeners felt as if they had already been decapitated the moment they heard the word “dying”. It would have been too late to realize it; their head would have been on the ground. The sensation made them stagger backward.

Xiaolou Tingxue was a peak primordial immortal. Was it enough to put up a fight against Li Qiye? All of a sudden, primordial immortals became the underdogs.

“I am afraid of death, but it is not the thing I fear the most, nor do I value life the most.” He said.

“I see, I understand. You may leave.” Li Qiye clapped and said.

“Although I like living, I want to try today.” He said.

“Why?” Li Qiye asked.

“If I yield today, it means I fear you, and this will consume me until I submit in the future, something I’ll never do. I would rather kill them first if I ever get the urge to submit.” He said.

“Fair enough, so you wish to try and kill me?” Li Qiye asked.

“Yes.” The moment he spoke, his saber energy nearly severed Dusk into two halves.

“Interesting, I will give you a chance to kill me.” Li Qiye nodded.

“I will do my best and show you my fangs.” He uttered coldly, preparing to face his death.

Unlike the other immortals who only cared about survival, he displayed no sign of fear like a passionate youth and put them to shame.

“Very good, even the smallest insect can still bark at the high heaven and bear its teeth, that is true.” Li Qiye said.
